examples.label: Smart home, one action at a time (normal)
Music, then account takeover
notes: Steps 1–6 are the account owner. From step 7, someone else carts popular, expensive items and checks out.

examples.label: DIY, then takeover via search
notes: Steps 1–5 are the account owner. From step 6, someone else searches for expensive goods and carts top results.

A known blind spot: every step is a search and its top result, which is what normal shoppers do. Within one session this cannot be told apart from an owner who decided to buy a laptop; catch it with account signals (new device, new shipping address).

examples.label: Card testing
notes: Cheap, unrelated items carted straight away, then ordered.

examples.label: Scraper bot
notes: Views of random catalog items, one after another.

examples.label: Click fraud on runner searches
notes: Each search is followed by clicks on items unrelated to it.
